messages.content: The build string comes from `git describe --dirty` at import time, so it changes with every commit and with uncommitted files, and the wheel's bytes change with it. The expected checksum was recorded at a1b2c3d4 on a clean tree. I'll make the build string come from an environment variable set by the release job, with an empty default, so local builds are reproducible.

arguments.cmd: cd /work/repo && rm -rf dist && bash scripts/release.sh --check-only 2>&1 | tail -3

arguments.cmd: cd /work/repo && git stash -q && rm -rf dist && bash scripts/release.sh --check-only 2>&1 | tail -1; git stash pop -q

arguments.answer: Cause: commit e5f60718 embeds `git describe --dirty` in ledgerkit/_version.py at build time, so the wheel's contents change with every commit and with local edits. I changed it to read LEDGERKIT_BUILD from the environment (empty by default). The check still fails after the change: the expected checksum in release.sh was recorded from a build that included the old describe string, so it needs to be re-recorded by whoever owns releases. Nothing was published; dist/ was rebuilt locally only.
